row.team_price_text: Basic: $350/mo for 10 users monthly; $3,780/yr for 10 users annually
row.evidence: Aikido's SAML guides say "Pro plans and up can enable SAML" and that people with access to the SAML app "will now be able to auto-onboard to your Aikido workspace"; no SCIM appears in the full help-centre export or the API reference.
row.notes: New row. Plans are priced per bundle of users: Developer free (2 users); Basic $350/mo, Pro $700/mo, Advanced $1,050/mo, each for 10 users on monthly billing (the default view); annual billing is 10% off (pricing data: Basic $3,780/yr, Pro $7,560/yr for 10 users), so per-user figures are annual: Basic $31.50, Pro $63. SAML SSO (Okta, Entra, Google Workspace, JumpCloud as custom SAML apps) is Pro and up and auto-onboards users on first login (JIT) with SAML Access Profiles for roles. Without SAML, users are auto-onboarded and offboarded from the connected GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket/Azure DevOps org. No SCIM; no IdP catalogue app found (Okta OIN and Entra gallery URLs 404). The public REST API (OAuth2 client credentials) lists and gets users, updates user rights and team membership, and lists login history; API plan gating not stated. 'None' is by absence (rule 5).

scim.notes: No SCIM mention anywhere in help.aikido.dev/llms-full.txt (full help-centre export, 0 matches) or the API reference index (apidocs.aikido.dev/llms.txt). Provisioning is SAML auto-onboarding (JIT) or Git-provider org sync. 'false' is by absence (rule 5).

endpoints.purpose: Update user rights (role admin/default/team_only, read-only and permission flags)

webhooks_user_events.notes: Webhook event types are issue and CI-gate events only.

audit_log_api.notes: Only a user login history endpoint was found.

rate_limits.text: 20 API calls per minute per workspace (50 on request); higher limits listed on Advanced.

limitations.text: No API endpoint to create, invite, deactivate or delete users was found in the reference index.

okta.notes: OIN URLs /integrations/aikido/ and /aikido-security/ return 404; Aikido's guide uses a custom SAML 2.0 app integration (SSO only).

entra.notes: No Entra gallery tutorial (aikido-tutorial, aikido-security-tutorial 404); Aikido documents a custom SAML app.

google.notes: Aikido documents a custom Google Workspace SAML app.

jumpcloud.notes: Aikido documents a custom JumpCloud SAML app.

fallbacks.other_sync: GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket Cloud and Azure DevOps organization sync (auto-onboarding and offboarding, team sync)
